title: Woman Steals Her Third Car After Being Released from Jail
description:
► Sonoran Desert Institute 
Learn more today at https://www.sdi.edu/code-blue-cam/  

On July 13, 2023, a stolen vehicle was reported in Tomah, WI. Law enforcement spotted it, leading to a high-speed chase and a crash. The driver, who had a history of vehicle thefts and was already on bond for such offenses, displayed erratic behavior attributed to recent drug use (meth and heroin). Following this incident, she failed to appear in court by late August, resulting in a bench warrant for her arrest.
